comment: A physical or virtual location where courses are offered.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the campus, auto-generated by the database.

columns.name: uuid
columns.comment: Stable external identifier for the campus (e.g. for APIs/integrations), independent of the internal auto-generated id.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Short, human-memorable static code for the campus, unique system-wide -- unlike id (not static) or uuid (unique but not memorable).

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Optional free-text description of the campus.
